2) Name/email for the procurement delegate and whether you prefer embedded signing.

Tessa — looked through Helix redlines (Helix_MSA_redlines_20260513.pdf). Legal is comfortable with the commercial concessions marked as negotiated, but we need to confirm two small items before final sign-off:

1) Section 7.4 (data residency exception): Helix added a carve-out for EU patient data. We need an explicit statement that production inference endpoints will not route EU patient PII outside designated regions. Please ask Evan to confirm in writing.
2) Exhibit A attachment: Helix inserted a custom SLA metric for 99.5% availability for their dedicated pool. If they want SLA in the MSA we need to route that to contracts for an amendment to the order form to capture the tier and pricing.

If they confirm the data residency note in email and either remove or accept the SLA change as a commercial term in the OF, Legal will approve the redlines for execution.
